function.name: WriteToFile
function.description: Create file and write content to a specified file path. The default filename would be 'temp.txt', or overwrites it if it does.

path.description: The absolute or relative file path to write to

content.description: The text content to write into the file

imageName.description: the docker image name if sandbox type is docker

vmName.description: the vm host name if sandbox type is vm
